welcome.speaker: bram
welcome.text: So you are the one who has taken the old cottage. Welcome to Hearthvale. It is the thatched house at the west end of the lane, and the plot by the well is yours.

settle.speaker: bram
settle.text: Settle in. Take the tools by your door, till a patch and put a seed in it. Tilda sells more seed in the red house. Come and see me when your first crop is in the ground.

greet.speaker: bram
greet.text: Ah, come in, come in. Have you seen the lights over the old keep at night?

options.text: I'm keeping watch, as I promised.
The keep is quiet. The Warden fell.

lights.speaker: bram
lights.text: Something has stirred in the keep north of here. Someone sharp-eyed ought to keep watch.

promise.speaker: bram
promise.text: Bless you. I will have the chain taken off the keep's gate. Take the old wooden sword from the training yard, then go north past the chapel, through the fields and the Old Wood.

kept.speaker: bram
kept.text: Good. I sleep easier for it. The gate is unchained. The road north past the chapel leads through the fields and the Old Wood to the keep.

tale.speaker: bram
tale.text: Then the old tale is true, and I sent you to break a lock. Long ago Sir Aldric bound a Shade under our chapel, and set the Warden to watch it. With the Warden fallen, the bars will not hold past dawn.

tale_next.speaker: bram
tale_next.text: Finish what Aldric began. It is dark down there, so find a light before you go deep. They say his sword still lies in his tomb.

ended.speaker: bram
ended.text: Gone? Then Hearthvale can sleep, and there will be no more lights over the keep. You have done what Aldric could not. We will not forget it.
